observations: Photo 0 shows a large flat-screen TV displaying an Android TV interface with a 'Wi-Fi is not connected' message. The time shown is 4:19. The screen has a black bezel, and the TV is mounted on a white wall with a power outlet above it. A watermark 'POSTED ON JUJ ENOCHBIZ' is visible.

Photo 1 shows the same TV displaying a colorful image of a red soccer cleat on a red and black soccer ball on a cobblestone surface. The screen is bright and clear, with the same watermark. The TV is in the same position as in photo 0.
No brand or model is visible on the TV frame or screen in either photo.
The TV appears to be powered on and displaying content in both photos, suggesting it is functional.

claims.claim: Sony android 55 inches smart UHD 4k TV
claims.evidence: No brand or model is visible in either photo. The interface resembles Android TV, but the brand cannot be confirmed from the images.
Origin and condition cannot be verified from photos alone. 'First grade' is subjective and not visually verifiable.
No accessories are visible in the photos. The seller claims they are included, but there is no visual proof.

risks.risk: TV is not a Sony or does not meet UHD 4K specifications
risks.proof: A clear photo of the TV bezel or back panel showing the brand and model name.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 55 inch smart TV, not as a Sony or 4K UHD model.

risks.risk: TV has physical damage or defects not visible in the photos
risks.proof: A 360-degree video or multiple photos showing all sides, edges, and corners of the TV, including the back and stand.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential hidden damage, which may reduce value.

risks.risk: Accessories are missing or not included as claimed
risks.proof: Photos of all accessories (remote, power cable, HDMI cables, etc.) laid out next to the TV.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if accessories are not included, which reduces value.

risks.risk: TV is not functional or has software issues
risks.proof: A video showing the TV turning on, navigating the menu, connecting to Wi-Fi, and playing content from different sources.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially non-functional or with software issues, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the TV bezel or back panel showing the brand and model name.
Photos of all accessories included with the TV.
Video showing the TV turning on, navigating the menu, connecting to Wi-Fi, and playing content.
360-degree photos or video showing all sides, edges, and corners of the TV.
response.reason: The brand and model cannot be confirmed from the photos, and the claim of 'complete accessories' is unverified. The TV appears functional, but without proof of brand, model, and accessories, a reliable price cannot be determined. Additional proof is needed to verify the claims and assess hidden risks.
